headline: Fourteen days in a harbour town.
image_prompt: Wooden crates of glass bottles on a stone quay at early morning, mooring ropes, pale light on the water, no people
why: Time and place are things a factory drink cannot claim. The number makes the slowness concrete, and the quay is ours.
